text:
The cargo liaison brought up a concern about traveler questions after reading your honest letter, and we understand that the handling of a companion animal can feel deeply personal when the trip does not go the way you expected. You explained that the support you received left you feeling brushed aside, and that the guidance around your pet's care and transfer was not as clear or reassuring as it should have been.

We are sorry for the stress that caused. At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk expects every traveler to receive calm, plain guidance before departure, and we want each handoff to feel careful and respectful. The ground team is trained to move carriers with care between services, and when something feels off, we review it step by step so the right people can look at the whole path the pet took. <<FACT F120>> If the concerns involved a missing or escaped companion animal, we also want to make sure the claim path is handled with care and without unnecessary friction.

What matters most now is that your experience is heard and taken seriously. We can review the booking notes, the transfer record, and the service comments to see where the process fell short, and we can pass along your complaint so the local team has a chance to respond with more detail. If Harley or another companion was involved, we will keep the focus on clear communication, respectful treatment, and practical next steps that help restore trust.

You should not have had to chase clarity after already dealing with the worry of travel. We are sorry for that, and we appreciate you speaking up so the matter can be examined with care. Thank you for giving us the chance to listen and make this right.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
